data.name: contact_update_internal
data.php_content:
<?
 
/*
* CPMObjectEventHandler: contact_update_internal
* Package: RN
* Objects: Contact
* Actions: Update
* Version: 1.3
*/
 
// This object procedure binds to v1_3 of the Connect PHP API
use \RightNow\Connect\v1_3 as RNCPHP;
 
// This object procedure binds to the v1 interface of the process
// designer
use \RightNow\CPM\v1 as RNCPM;
 
/**
* An Object Event Handler must provide two classes:
* - One with the same name as the CPMObjectEventHandler tag
* above that implements the ObjectEventHandler interface.
* - And one of the same name with a "_TestHarness" suffix
* that implements the ObjectEventHandler_TestHarness interface.
*
* Each method must have an implementation.
*/
 
class contact_update_internal implements RNCPM\ObjectEventHandler
{
	public static function apply( $run_mode, $action, $obj, $n_cycles )
	{
		
		try 
		{
			if ($obj->Name->First != $obj->prev->Name->First) {
				try{
					$query = RNCPHP\ROQL::queryObject(sprintf("SELECT SocialUser FROM SocialUser WHERE SocialUser.Contact = %d", $obj->ID))->next();
					if($socialuser = $query->next()){
						$socialuser->DisplayName = $obj->Name->First;
						$socialuser->save(RNCPHP\RNObject::SuppressAll);
					}
				}
				catch(RNCPHP\ConnectAPIErrorBase $e){
					throw $e;
				}
			}

		}
		catch (RNCPHP\ConnectAPIError $err)  
		{
			$logger = "Exception: ".$err->getCode();
			$logger .= "\nMessage: ".$err->getMessage();
			echo("Exception Message was: " . $err->getMessage() );
			throw $err;			
		}
		
		return;
	} // apply()
 
 	static function setPrimaryOrgId($contact)
    {
		$result = false;
		if ($contact->ID)
		{
			try{
				$conquery = RNCPHP\ROQL::query("SELECT CustomFields.c.org_id_temp FROM Contact WHERE ID = ".$contact->ID)->next();
			}
			catch(RNCPHP\ConnectAPIErrorBase $e){
				throw $e;
			}
			if($conrow = $conquery->next()){
				$primaryOrgId = intval($conrow['org_id_temp']);
			}
			if($primaryOrgId > 0) {
				$result = true;
				$contact->Organization = RNCPHP\Organization::fetch($primaryOrgId);
				try{
					$query = RNCPHP\ROQL::query("SELECT ID, Org, IsPrimary FROM CO.ContactOrgJoin WHERE Contact = ".$contact->ID)->next();
				}
				catch(RNCPHP\ConnectAPIErrorBase $e){
					throw $e;
				}
				while($row = $query->next()){
					$joinId = intval($row['ID']);
					$orgId = intval($row['Org']);
					$isPrimary = intval($row['IsPrimary']);
					if ($orgId == $primaryOrgId) {
						if ($isPrimary != 1) {
							self::updateContactOrgJoin($joinId, 1);
						}
					}
					else {
						if ($isPrimary != 0) {
							self::updateContactOrgJoin($joinId, 0);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
        return $result;
    }

	function updateContactOrgJoin($joinId, $isPrimary) {
		// \RightNow\Libraries\AbuseDetection::check();
		//echo "contact_id: $contact_id, org_id: $org_id, isPrimary: $isPrimary";
		try{
			$coj = RNCPHP\CO\ContactOrgJoin::fetch($joinId);
			$coj->IsPrimary = $isPrimary;
			$coj->save();		
		}
		catch (Exception $err ){
			echo $err->getMessage();
			throw $err;			
		}
	}

} // class contact_update_internal
 
 
/*
The Test Harness
*/
 
 
class contact_update_internal_TestHarness implements RNCPM\ObjectEventHandler_TestHarness
{
	static $contact_invented = NULL;
	 
	public static function setup()
	{
		// For this test, create a new
		// contact as expected.
		$contact = new RNCPHP\Contact;
		$contact->Name = new RNCPHP\PersonName();
		$contact->Name->First = "Sample_first";
		$contact->Name->Last = "Sample_last";
		 
		static::$contact_invented = $contact;
		return;
	}
	 
	public static function fetchObject( $action, $object_type )
	{
		// Return the object that we
		// want to test with.
		// You could also return an array of objects
		// to test more than one variation of an object.
		return(static::$contact_invented);
	}
	 
	public static function validate( $action, $object )
	{
		// assume validation is OK
		return true;
	}
	 
	public static function cleanup()
	{
		// Destroy every object invented
		// by this test.
		// Not necessary since in test
		// mode and nothing is committed,
		// but good practice if only to
		// document the side effects of
		// this test.
		
			try
			{
				static::$contact_invented->destroy();
			}
			catch (RNCPHP\ConnectAPIError $err)  
			{
				$logger = "Exception: ".$err->getCode();
				$logger .= "\nMessage: ".$err->getMessage();
				//throw $err;
			}
		
		static::$contact_invented = NULL;
		return;
	}
}
data.key_logic: This Oracle Service Cloud CPM PHP custom procedure code updates a contact's social user display name and sets the primary organization ID when a contact's first name is updated. The code handles exceptions and errors, and includes a test harness to validate the functionality of the custom procedure.
